GE05 q background q00=0 and Xphi00=0
required_exact_identities: E_qj00 = 0 for every regular GE05 bath node
sum_i E_i00 dchi(F_i21) = 0 for arbitrary F21
L21 E_L00 - b21 E_b00 = 0 for arbitrary L21,b21

Do not reinterpret historical D10, D22A, Repair37 or other failures.
